mug_tomas: I assumed static locations, but it moves frequently. At 08:55 it was at kitchen_table_k1, not sink_k1. It circulates between kitchen_table_k1, cupboard_k1, and desk_o1. Check kitchen_table_k1 for early morning queries.

charger_tomas: I incorrectly assumed it stayed at nightstand_b1 in the morning and late night. At 09:26 it was at desk_o1, and at 22:59 it was at bedroom_floor_b1. It moves between desk_o1 (daytime), nightstand_b1 (evening), and bedroom_floor_b1 (late night). Check desk_o1 for morning queries and bedroom_floor_b1 for very late queries.

water_bottle_tomas: I assumed it was at dining_table_d1 in the afternoon and late night, but at 13:46 it was at desk_o1 and at 22:59 it was at dish_rack_k1. It moves between desk_o1 (daytime), dining_table_d1 (evening), and dish_rack_k1 (late night). Check desk_o1 for afternoon queries and dish_rack_k1 for very late queries.

glass_tomas: I assumed it was at nightstand_b1 late at night, but at 22:59 it was at cupboard_k1. It circulates between dining_table_d1, kitchen_table_k1, nightstand_b1, and cupboard_k1. Check cupboard_k1 for late-night queries.
